subject.title: fix(plugins): let URL parse errors propagate in shouldRequireManifestInstallSourceRef

question: Should malformed external-plugin catalog feed/profile URLs now fail the catalog operation with an actionable diagnostic, or should OpenClaw preserve the existing strict-manifest fallback?
rationale: The patch deliberately changes compatibility behavior for invalid persisted configuration; source policy favors canonical configuration, but the exact user-facing catalog failure contract needs an owner decision.

options.title: Adopt fail-fast validation
options.body: Confirm that malformed catalog URLs are configuration errors, then require a focused caller-path test and redacted runtime output showing the actionable diagnostic.

options.title: Preserve strict fallback
options.body: Keep the existing `return true` behavior and improve validation earlier only if a non-breaking diagnostic path is available.

recommendation.title: Adopt fail-fast validation
recommendation.body: Confirm that malformed catalog URLs are configuration errors, then require a focused caller-path test and redacted runtime output showing the actionable diagnostic.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a core/plugin configuration-contract choice rather than a contributor-proof-only question.
